attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS file_path
FROM code.files f
JOIN code.imports i ON f.file_id = i.file_id
WHERE f.is_test = FALSE
  AND f.module IS NOT NULL
  AND i.imported_file_id IN (
    SELECT file_id
    FROM code.files
    WHERE package = 'auto_ontology.connectors'
      OR module LIKE 'auto_ontology.connectors.%'
  )
  AND f.file_id NOT IN (
    SELECT file_id
    FROM code.files
    WHERE file_id LIKE '%/tests/%'
      OR file_id LIKE '%/test_%'
      OR file_id LIKE '%/tests'
  );
